jobs.description:
Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We are bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources while supporting the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.

We are seeking a Geotechnical Engineer to join our Geosciences team in Melbourne. This is an exciting opportunity for an early career professional looking to further develop their technical capability and gain exposure to a diverse range of projects across Australia and globally.

Working within a collaborative and highly skilled team, you will contribute to projects across infrastructure, water, renewables, mining and energy sectors. We are proud to work on such diverse projects including infrastructure, water, solar, onshore and offshore wind, mining (open pit and underground), as well as onshore and offshore projects for renewables and hydrocarbons. These diverse projects are delivered in Australia and globally, drawing on our broad technical expertise.

The Role

As a Geotechnical Engineer, You Will

- Provide geotechnical engineering support across infrastructure, mining, renewables and energy projects, with a strong focus on safety and quality.

- Scope, plan and supervise geotechnical site investigations, including borehole drilling, CPTs and test pits.

- Log soils and rock in accordance with relevant Australian Standards.

- Prepare technical reports, proposals and engineering recommendations.

- Support construction activities and site-based investigations as required.

- Undertake geotechnical analyses using industry-standard software packages.

- Collaborate with multidisciplinary project teams to deliver high-quality outcomes for our customers.

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related discipline.

- Relevant experience in geotechnical engineering, including exposure to site investigations and geotechnical logging.

- Membership of, or progress towards membership with, a recognised professional institution.

- Strong report writing, communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

- Experience using geotechnical engineering software packages.

- Willingness to undertake occasional regional or international travel when required.

- Current Australian driver's licence.

- Australian working rights.

Why Worley?

When you work for us, you get the chance to join nearly 50,000 people all driven by a common purpose: delivering a more sustainable world.

We're excited about the challenges ahead. If you ask us, there's never been a more rewarding time to work in the energy, chemicals and resources sectors.

What We Offer

- Flexible and hybrid working arrangements.

- Competitive remuneration and employee benefits.

- Access to Worley's global learning and development platform.

- Exposure to a broad range of local and international projects.

- Career development opportunities within a global organisation.

- The opportunity to contribute to projects supporting the energy transition and a more sustainable future.

Our Benefits

- Flexible work arrangements to help you achieve work-life balance.

- Competitive salary package and employee share opportunities where applicable.

- Paid parental leave and inclusive family support benefits.

- Professional development and career growth opportunities.

- Employee assistance and wellbeing programmes.

- Access to a global network of expertise, projects and career pathways.

- A diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

Moving forward together

We want our people to be energised and empowered to drive sustainable impact. Our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.

We are building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves and are heard.

We are committed to reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low-carbon energy infrastructure and technology.

Ready to apply?

If you're looking to take the next step in your geotechnical engineering career and contribute to delivering a more sustainable world, we'd love to hear from you.

Applications will close on the date specified in the advertisement. We reserve the right to commence candidate selection and appointments prior to the closing date, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Principal Adviser Civil/Structural Engineering
jobs.summary: - Influence the quality, safety and performance of Rio Tinto's global project portfolio by providing civil and structural engineering leadership, assurance and technical governance
jobs.description:
- Influence the quality, safety and performance of Rio Tinto's global project portfolio by providing civil and structural engineering leadership, assurance and technical governance

- Work alongside senior engineering leaders, major engineering service providers and project teams to shape critical mining and processing projects from study through execution

- Role based in Perth or Brisbane with flexible work arrangements and occasional travel across Rio Tinto's global project portfolio

We’re Finding Better Ways to provide materials the world needs, now and in the future. Our values – care, courage and curiosity – guide how we work and how we treat each other.

About The Role

We are looking for a Principal Adviser - Civil & Structural Engineering to help Rio Tinto Projects deliver safe, fit-for-purpose and high-quality engineering outcomes across a global portfolio of major capital projects. In this role, you’ll provide discipline leadership, independent technical assurance, governance and specialist expertise across study, design and execution phases. This is a prime opportunity to join a highly respected technical team and influence some of the world’s most significant mining and minerals processing projects.

Reporting to the Manager of Engineering Engagement, you will partner closely with engineering managers, project teams and engineering service providers to strengthen technical definition, manage engineering risk and improve engineering delivery practices across Rio Tinto Projects.

What You’ll Be Doing

- Lead the development and continuous improvement of civil and structural engineering standards, specifications, frameworks and governance requirements

- Provide independent technical review, challenge and specialist advice to project teams, Engineering Managers and key stakeholders

- Support engineering health checks, assurance reviews and technical governance activities to verify compliance with Rio Tinto and industry standards

- Contribute to technical definition, basis of design development and engineering strategies during studies and project execution

- Resolve critical engineering challenges by collaborating with project teams and engineering service providers on constructability, design and risk matters

- Support portfolio-wide engineering performance monitoring and delivery of assurance programs across multiple projects

- Coach and mentor engineers, share lessons learned and strengthen capability through communities of practice and technical leadership

- Monitor emerging technologies, industry developments and leading practices to improve engineering outcomes and whole-of-life asset value

About You

We’re looking for someone whose experience aligns with the key requirements below. You do not need to meet every ‘helpful for success’ item to apply. If you are excited by the opportunity and bring relevant experience, we encourage you to apply.

*Required for Success*

- A commitment to the safety of yourself and your team

- Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering or a related discipline, together with Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng) status or equivalent professional registration

- Demonstrated experience providing civil and/or structural engineering leadership within mining, resources, heavy industrial, infrastructure or major capital project environments

- Experience supporting projects across study, design and execution phases, including working with multidisciplinary engineering teams, EPC/EPCM contractors and engineering service providers

- Strong knowledge of engineering governance, standards, assurance, technical risk management and independent review processes within safety-critical environments

- Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and solve complex engineering challenges through technical expertise, collaboration and sound judgement

*Helpful for Success*

- Experience in owner’s engineering, technical governance, assurance, design review or engineering audit roles

- Exposure to major mining and minerals processing projects with global stakeholder engagement

- Postgraduate qualifications in Engineering, Project Management, Risk Management or Business

If you think you have what it takes but your experience does not align perfectly with every item, we would still like to hear from you.

What We Offer

Be recognised for your contribution, your thinking and your hard work, and go home knowing you’ve helped the world progress.

- A work environment where safety is always the number one priority

- A permanent position working directly for Rio Tinto

- A competitive base salary reflective of your skills and experience with annual incentive program

- Comprehensive medical benefits including subsidised private health insurance for employees and immediate family

- Attractive share ownership plan

- Company provided insurance cover

- Extensive salary sacrifice & salary packaging options

- Career development & education assistance to further your technical or leadership ambitions

- Ongoing access to family-friendly health and medical wellbeing support

- Leave for all of life’s reasons (vacation/annual, paid parental, sick & cultural leave)

- Exclusive employee discounts (banking, accommodation, cars, retail and more)

Where you’ll be working

Brisbane Office

Located on Charlotte Street in the heart of Brisbane’s city, our modern, multi-floor office is thoughtfully designed for connection and collaboration, no matter where our people are located around the world. The space includes technology-enabled work and meeting areas, shared social lounges, and The Pit, our auditorium and central place for events and gatherings. On-site amenities include a wellness room, parents’ suite, and multi-faith room. Downstairs, just inside the building’s heritage façade, are end-of-journey facilities and an urban laneway with coffee shops and pastry kitchen. Our teams enjoy views of Moreton Bay, Kangaroo Point and the Brisbane River as they work across a range of technical and functional disciplines, supporting operations globally.

Perth Office - Central Park

Our modern office located in Central Park tower in Perth provide an inspiring environment for collaboration and professional growth. You'll be able to enjoy a range of benefits, including access to a modern gym, wellness programs, and convenient amenities that support a healthy work-life balance. Situated in the heart of Perth, we are close to public transport and several parking options.

About Rio Tinto

Rio Tinto is a leading global mining and materials company. We operate in 35 countries where we produce iron ore, copper, aluminium, critical minerals, and other materials needed for the global energy transition and for people, communities, and nations to thrive.

We have been mining for 150 years and operate with knowledge built up across generations and continents. Our purpose is finding better ways to provide the materials the world needs – striving for innovation and continuous improvement to produce materials with low emissions and to the right environmental, social and governance standards. But we can’t do it on our own, so we’re focused on creating partnerships to solve problems, create win-win situations and meet opportunities.

Respect and Inclusion

At Rio Tinto, we particularly welcome and encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, women, the LGBTQ+ community, mature workers, people with disabilities and people from different cultural backgrounds.

We are committed to an inclusive environment where people feel comfortable to be themselves. We want our people to feel that all voices are heard, all cultures respected and that a variety of perspectives are not only welcome – they are essential to our success. We treat each other fairly and with dignity regardless of race, gender, nationality, ethnic origin, religion, age, sexual orientation or anything else that makes us different.

jobs.description:
What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

At WSP you’ll find the scale and reach you need to do the kind of work the world needs – and the culture and people that make it the best work of your life.

Our Mining & Metals group is a leader in future-led end to end mining solutions and delivery of services to our clients. We specialise in delivering comprehensive and tailored solutions for the mining industry. Our team manages and executes large-scale capital projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality and safety and leave a lasting positive legacy in the communities we engage with.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Structural Engineer to join our Sustaining Capital team in Perth, supporting a portfolio of Tier 1 mining clients across Western Australia.

Working across a variety of commodities and brownfield mining environments, you’ll deliver structural engineering solutions for sustaining capital, upgrades, modifications and remediation projects. This is a hands-on technical role suited to an engineer with strong mining and materials handling experience who is comfortable working with both existing and new structures.

- Deliver structural engineering and design across brownfield mining and minerals processing projects

- Design and check structural steelwork, reinforced concrete and foundations

- Work across conveyors, transfer stations, crushing and screening structures, chutes, pipe racks, platforms and equipment support structures

- Assess existing structures and develop modification, remediation and strengthening solutions

- Provide engineering support through design, fabrication and construction and review structural models, drawings and vendor information

- Respond to technical queries and work closely with designers, engineers, contractors and client teams

- Check and review the work of other engineers and provide technical guidance where required

About you

- Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Structural Engineering

- Significant experience as a Structural Engineer within mining, minerals processing or heavy industrial projects

- Strong background working within an EPCM or engineering consultancy environment

- Strong structural steel and reinforced concrete design capability

- Experience with materials handling infrastructure, particularly conveyors and associated structures

- Sound knowledge of Australian structural design standards

- Ability to work independently, undertake checking and solve complex structural problems

- Strong communication skills and confidence engaging with multidisciplinary and client teams

Why WSP?

You’ll join an established Sustaining Capital team delivering a diverse pipeline of work for some of WA’s largest mining operators. With projects spanning multiple commodities and operating assets, you’ll have the opportunity to work on varied and technically challenging brownfield projects rather than being tied to one major greenfield development.

If you’re an experienced structural engineer who enjoys solving complex problems within existing mining operations, we’d love to hear from you.

- Inclusive and diverse workplace culture supported by employee networks, reconciliation initiatives and belonging programs

- Internal career development programs and structured career planning resources

- Flexible and hybrid working arrangements

- Active social clubs and office events, including networking, sporting activities, celebrations and community initiatives

- Be part of a well-established and supportive local team

jobs.title: Senior Maritime Structural Engineer
jobs.summary: Senior Maritime Structural Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Maritime Structural Engineer 

At Aurecon, we are optimistic about the future. We are thinkers, solvers, and collaborators who work with our clients to deliver the infrastructure and assets that strengthen communities and create a sustainable future.

What you’ll do 

As a Senior Maritime Structural Engineer for our Ports, Marine & Coastal team based in Brisbane , you’ll join Aurecon’s global centre of excellence and help shape, design and deliver major port, maritime and shipyard projects across Australia.

You’ll work alongside a highly regarded multidisciplinary team with a proud history of shaping port infrastructure across Queensland and beyond. Your work will span the full project lifecycle, from early studies and concept development through to detailed design, delivery and the transformation of existing assets. You will:

Lead and deliver marine structural and port engineering projects across different stages of the project lifecycle.
 Develop practical, bespoke structural solutions for complex maritime environments.
 Work on major defence shipyards, port authority infrastructure, container terminals and sustaining-capital programs.
 Contribute to green-energy export, offshore wind and public and recreational maritime projects.
 Build trusted relationships with port, resources, industrial, defence and energy clients.
 Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to achieve integrated project outcomes.
 Provide technical guidance and mentoring to developing engineers.
 Clearly communicate complex structural engineering concepts to clients, stakeholders and other disciplines.

What you’ll bring 

You’ll bring strong structural engineering fundamentals and substantial experience within marine, maritime or port infrastructure, supported by the ability to lead projects and build confidence with clients.

Relevant engineering qualifications and RPEQ (or working towards achieving RPEQ).
 Demonstrated structural engineering experience, ideally across ports, marine or maritime infrastructure.
 Experience shaping, leading and delivering projects from concept through to execution.
 Strong technical capability in marine structures and bespoke structural design.
 Client, stakeholder and project management skills.
 Clear communication skills and the ability to make complex engineering concepts easy to understand.
 A collaborative approach and a willingness to support and mentor other team members.
 A commitment to continuous learning and developing your career alongside recognised technical specialists.

How we support your growth 

We believe your career should be a rewarding adventure. You will tackle some of the world’s most complex infrastructure challenges, in an environment that supports your ambitions, where we hold ourselves, and each other, to the highest standards. Recognised by the AFR as a Best Place to Work in 2026, we embrace diverse perspectives, giving you the opportunity to make a real impact.

Who we are 

We are an engineering consultancy with more than 6,000 people across Australia, New Zealand and Asia. We believe the world needs people who can engineer possibilities; people who can create infrastructure that makes life better for people and the planet. That is why we are here – to bring ideas to life, the Aurecon way.

Ready for your next adventure?
